id: v-2-access-logs-index
title: "List access logs"
description: "Paginated feed of access events (lock opens/closes, gate activations, unit-access changes) across your locations. Each log carries three timestamps: `effective_at` is the one to sort and display — it equals `happened_at` when the device reported one, falling back to `created_at` (server receipt) for older hardware or offline-uploaded events where `happened_at` is null. Filter by `location`, `unit`, `key` (e.g. `lock.open_successful`), `log_type` (`units` / `entrypoints` / `locks`), and date range (`from` / `to` on `effective_at`). Results are paged (25 per page, `per_page` up to 100) with details in `meta.pagination`. Supports conditional requests via `ETag` / `If-None-Match` with a 60-second cache window. Needs the `read:logs` scope."

Paginated feed of access events (lock opens/closes, gate activations, unit-access changes) across your locations. Each log carries three timestamps: `effective_at` is the one to sort and display — it equals `happened_at` when the device reported one, falling back to `created_at` (server receipt) for older hardware or offline-uploaded events where `happened_at` is null. Filter by `location`, `unit`, `key` (e.g. `lock.open_successful`), `log_type` (`units` / `entrypoints` / `locks`), and date range (`from` / `to` on `effective_at`). Results are paged (25 per page, `per_page` up to 100) with details in `meta.pagination`. Supports conditional requests via `ETag` / `If-None-Match` with a 60-second cache window. Needs the `read:logs` scope.
